comment1: Params for prov_bulk.ts. Keys starting with 'comment' are ignored. Dry run unless --execute.
comment2: whereClause: required; same syntax as slideshow's whereClause (fotos columns). Deleted photos are never matched.
comment3: orderBy: order of the photos in the list (and which come first with --limit). Default: path, name.
comment4: existing — photos that already have a prov row: 'skip' = leave alone (default); 'fill' = write only their blank columns; 'overwrite' = write every column listed in set.
comment5: set: only the columns listed are touched — delete a line to leave that column as it is. "" or null = blank (clears it with overwrite). Ranks: 1-5 or null. Every photo gets the same values.
